rationale: The assistant correctly identified side-wall condenser heat as normal, asked the right first checks (gaps, temperatures, smell/tripping/scorching) and set a sensible stop-use boundary, matching the hidden truth and acceptable directions. It respected the customer's refusal to pull the unit out and did not fabricate evidence or recommend parts. Weaknesses: the stray 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it' in turn two was unnecessary and confused the customer (requiring a clarifying turn), the attached 'Fridge not cooling' card was irrelevant to a fridge that cools fine, and the safety-stop list was restated each turn; it also never pinned down the model to look up the actual clearance figures.
